items.title: A Look at Some of Our Favorite Cinematic Suite Tools in Topview's Film Studio 2.0
items.excerpt: No Film School breaks down the most useful AI tools in Topview's Film Studio 2.0 cinematic suite, pitching it as a platform for AI filmmaking and for using AI to assist traditional filmmaking.

items.title: 'VelociPastor 2' Leaves FilmQuest Audience Roaring, Celebrating Human-Made Films in an AI Era
items.excerpt: At Utah genre festival FilmQuest, AI's spread in the industry met near-universal distrust; one of the biggest applause lines before every screening was a promise that the feature contained no AI.
items.strength: medium (festival AI policy angle; AI is framing, review-heavy)

items.title: 'The Loud House' Moves S10 Production To Canada, Director Says
items.excerpt: Jessica Borutski and Maxwell Atoms discuss lost jobs and AI; neither has seen AI implemented in their studios' workflows, naming Animaj's 'Ozzy Fox' collaboration as the lone exception they know of.
items.strength: weak-medium (AI is one discussion thread; runaway production is the lead)

items.title: Aardman at 50: Keeping Animation Independent and Hand-Made
items.excerpt: Facing consolidation and the rise of AI, employee-owned Aardman bets on handmade stop-motion; the studio draws a sharp line against generative AI but is open to digital tools that improve production efficiency.
items.strength: medium (studio genAI policy; AI is a section, not the lead)

items.title: Jennifer Siebel Newsom Thinks It's Time Tech Leaders Faced Accountability
items.excerpt: Her new documentary 'Miss Representation: Rise Up' argues social platforms and AI tools have been weaponized to harass and silence women and girls.
items.strength: weak (AI is documentary subject, no craft hook)

items.title: Hiding In Plain Sight: Top Execs On Unlocking The Value In Legacy IP
items.excerpt: An ACF/Deadline MIPCOM roundtable on legacy IP covers AI monetization of libraries, including Versos AI, which licenses studios' dormant footage as AI training data.
items.strength: medium (AI training-data licensing of film libraries is one section)
items.expansion_term: studio library AI training licensing (Versos AI)

items.title: Ex-Disney & NBCU Execs Among New Advisory Board At Pzaz
items.excerpt: Storyboarding and previsualisation platform Pzaz, which lets creatives build storyboards and visuals in minutes with a proprietary AI system, adds former Disney, NBCU and Bloomberg TV execs to its advisory board.
items.strength: weak (exec-board news; AI previs tool is the hook)

items.title: RisingJoy Signs International Distribution Pact With NTT DOCOMO
items.excerpt: RisingJoy commits to 30 vertical anime titles by Q1 2027, saying AI production tools let it reach a scale and cadence conventional animation cannot support.
items.strength: medium (AI production of vertical anime; distribution deal is the lead)

items.title: 브이캣, 일본 TV아사히 사극 '사나다 주유시' AI 영상 제작 참여…넷플릭스 공개
items.excerpt: Korean AI video studio VCAT produced AI shots for TV Asahi/Toei's 7-part period drama, combining live action with AI and VFX for difficult action scenes; the series airs on TV Asahi and streams on Netflix, and an AI-only promo ran in Times Square.
items.expansion_term: Japanese AI drama production / AI VFX in broadcast drama

items.title: 허드슨에이아이, 더빙 제작부터 품질 검수까지 AI로 통합…콘텐츠 현지화 자동화 기술 공개
items.excerpt: Hudson AI unveiled a localization AI agent that identifies 40+ speakers, separates overlapping speech and reads character relationships to generate multilingual dubs, automating over 90% of QC; it is in proof-of-concept with global media companies after MIPCOM.
items.strength: strong (off-list: AI dubbing, no allowed-domain coverage)

items.title: "장편 제작에 70억원? 다른 방법은 없을까"…홍정민 스튜디오 여우별 대표가 AI에 뛰어든 이유
items.excerpt: Studio Yeoubyeol's Hong Jeong-min uses generative AI (Seedance 2.0, Suno) to cut the cost of feature animation; his 90-second AI short 'Stitching Heart', made in about 10 hours, won an Honorable Mention among 648 entries from 67 countries.
items.expansion_term: AI 애니메이션 제작 / AI short film award

items.title: Netflix deploys up to 60 specialists per language to bring Korean culture to global audiences
items.excerpt: At a Netflix-KOCCA localization roundtable, Netflix's Catherine Letarte said human-led dubbing and subtitling remain essential: 'AI can assist with the work, but it is only a tool that supports specialists.'
items.strength: weak-medium (off-list; AI stance is a section of a localization story)
